description: Simulate paying only the minimum payment on a revolving credit card balance every month, where the minimum payment is whichever is larger of a percent of the current balance or a fixed dollar floor. Reports months and years to payoff, total interest, total paid, and the first vs. final month's payment amount, so the "minimum payment trap" becomes visible.

aprPercent.description: Annual percentage rate, as a percent

minPaymentFloor.description: Fixed dollar floor for the minimum payment, default 0

minPaymentPercent.description: Minimum payment as a percent of the current balance, as a percent

name: calculate_credit_card_minimum_payment
